in_sanskrit.name: देवकार्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one whose work is ordained by God

in_marathi.name: Devkarth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devkarth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devkarth is derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Deva’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Karth’ meaning ‘work’. This name signifies that the individual is engaged in divine work, serving the higher purpose of the universe.
